title: Honour an exclusion exactly
objective: A Customer who says no meat is never shown meat. Measurement established that matching by meaning gets this backwards, so it is a filter and never a phrase.
acceptance_criteria: an excluded food appears ZERO times across the exclusion test set — one occurrence is a failure of the feature, not a ranking miss (SC-005)
a Meal whose relevant field is empty is WITHHELD, not shown (FR-021) — an unknown is a possible yes
an exclusion is never relaxed to fill the screen (FR-020)
a recognised negation marker whose noun does not map returns the unparsed marker, and Kafoo says it did not understand — it NEVER returns results as though no exclusion was asked for
discovery_exclusion_test.sql written and SEEN TO FAIL first
the interface states what was filtered on and NEVER states that a Meal is safe
blocked_reason: Four of the five reserved vocabulary decisions are taken and merged to the working branch (مايونيز, تونة, جوز-left-out, مبكلش/مباكلش). Blocked on the fifth (كندوز / ضاني / مبحبش) AND on eight further decisions the four review agents surfaced on 2026-08-10, listed in the notes. Three of those are silent-failure paths on allergy phrasing and one is a test that cannot fail.
notes:
grok-4.5 because this is health-adjacent and the model table reserves that row for subtle logic near safety. Measured 2026-08-06: asking for food with no meat returned meat dishes, first correct answer at rank 6, precision@5 of 0.00. A Customer excluding a food is usually doing so for dietary, religious or health reasons, so serving them the opposite is a betrayal rather than a poor result. The sharp edge is that meals.allergens is frequently an AI estimate carrying nutrition_source — hence 'states what it filtered on, never that a Meal is safe'. Touches search_meals, which WP-013 created; serialised behind it by dependency.

localization-reviewer 2026-08-07 found THREE CRITICAL BUGS by running the code, all fixed with tests seen to fail first: (a) 'عندي حساسية من المكسرات' returned NoExclusion — an allergy stated plainly, nothing excluded, nothing said; (b) the markers were masculine only, so 'مش عايزة لحمة' reported not-understood on 'ة لحمة' — half the customer base on mainstream phrasing; (c) matching was loose on the Cook's side and exact on the Customer's, so 'من غير اللحمة' failed on the definite article. It also found the gluten entry unusable by a coeliac (flour named, bread and pasta not) and butter and ghee missing from dairy. All addressed.

STILL OPEN, DELIBERATELY, AND NEEDING A HUMAN:
1. 'بيض' matches inside 'أبيض' and 'بيضاء' — فلفل أبيض, أرز أبيض, جبنة بيضاء. Anyone excluding eggs loses a large slice of the marketplace. Over-exclusion is the safe direction, so this is not urgent, but it is the most frequent false positive in the list. A word-boundary match would fix it and would change the SQL predicate, not just this file.
2. NO NORMALISATION ANYWHERE. Correctness rests on hand-enumerating every ة/ه, أ/ا/إ and ي/ى variant, which is why they were applied inconsistently. Folding both sides — the way normalise_area already does for areas — collapses about a third of the list. It is a two-sided change: the SQL predicate must fold `item` identically or the two stop agreeing.
3. Judgement calls left untaken rather than guessed: 'مايونيز' under egg (excluding mayonnaise would also exclude all eggs, because one form set serves both directions), 'تونة' under fish (it is inside 'زيتونة'), 'جوز' under nuts (it is inside 'جوز الهند', so coconut goes with walnuts).
4. Words the reviewer was unsure Cooks TYPE rather than say: كندوز, ضاني, مبحبش. Want a native Cairene ear before they go in.

MERGED in #54 on 2026-08-07 (squash). The enumeration gap in note 2 is closed; notes 1, 3 and 4 stay open and are the founder's.

NOTE 1 IS MEASURED 2026-08-08 AND THE FIX IT PROPOSED DOES NOT WORK. packages/domain/test/exclusion_over_exclusion_test.dart walks the vocabulary against 70 pieces of Cook-side text — every ingredient list pinned in the meal_analysis goldens, everything in seed.sql, and the multi-word entries a Cook produces by editing what the model proposed. 44 matches, 7 of them wrong, all seven either أبيض or ملبن.
- A word-boundary match on BOTH sides removes 14 more and 11 are CORRECT: جبنة, جبنة رومي, سمنة, لبنة, لحمة, لحمة مفرومة, كبدة, بيضة مسلوقة. Arabic glues its feminine and plural endings onto the back of a noun, so a right-hand boundary is silent under-exclusion wearing the clothes of precision. Not a candidate at any price.
- A LEFT-hand boundary alone fixes 7 and costs nothing measured — but it does NOT fix جبنة بيضاء, the case note 1 names, because بيضاء BEGINS with بيض. Nor خبز لبناني under dairy. And it buys those 7 with a closed list of Arabic clitics, which is the same shape of enumeration this package already watched fail when 13 spellings and one tatweel defeated the vocabulary — except this time anything unlisted fails toward under-exclusion.
So the predicate is UNCHANGED, deliberately. The 7 are recorded at their measured size and the suite goes red if a new surface form starts colliding with ordinary Cook text. ADR-0012 is where this gets fixed: a classifier reading فلفل أبيض produces no EGG concept because it is reading a word rather than a run of letters. ADR-0012's option A row and its over-exclusion paragraph were corrected with these numbers.

WHAT IS LEFT IN THIS PACKAGE IS FIVE DECISIONS AND NOTHING ELSE. All seven acceptance criteria are met. FOUR REVIEW AGENTS RAN THE CODE AND FOUND EIGHT THINGS. Every one below was re-measured by the dispatching session rather than taken on the agent's word. NONE is fixed; all are the founder's.

1. HIGH — تونا IS UNREACHABLE AND تونة ALONE MAKES IT WORSE. A Cook writing تونا, سلطة تونا or ساندوتش تونا is reached by nothing; من غير تونا returns not-understood. So a Customer says من غير سمك, Kafoo answers fish, says it removed سمك, and serves a tuna salad. Adding تونة without تونا converts silence into false reassurance on the exact case the decision was taken for. Recommend adding تونا, and ميونيز beside مايونيز on the same argument.
2. HIGH — THREE OF THE FOUR SPELLINGS OF 'I DON'T EAT' ARE STILL SILENT. The negation particle is ما and it is routinely written separately: مابكلش, ماباكلش, ما بكلش and ما باكلش all return NoExclusion — nothing excluded, nothing said. Measured: no food form is a substring of any of them, so there is no collision or ordering cost. Recommend adding all four.
3. HIGH — بس IS NOT A CONJUNCTION, SO A TRAILING CLAUSE BECOMES THE FOOD. مبكلش لحمة بس بحب الفراخ excludes CHICKEN, leaves the meat on screen, and tells the Customer it removed فراخ. A confident false statement on the phrasing most likely to carry a religious or medical rule. Pre-existing — من غير لحمة بس بحب الفراخ does the same — but the new markers multiply it onto habitual negation. Fix is بس in _conjunctions on both sides.
4. HIGH — THE pgTAP SWEEP CANNOT FAIL FOR MOST OF THE VOCABULARY. Proven by deleting مايونيز from the vocabulary: the suite stayed GREEN and simply reported '2 spelling(s) checked' instead of 4, because the generator derives the fixtures from the same source as the terms. rls-reviewer additionally measured that search_meals' LIMIT 50 against 154 tied embeddings means only ids 000-049 ever return, so 104 of 153 spellings are asserted against Meals the query can never produce, and 8 of 12 SC-005 assertions cannot fail — peanut, nuts and gluten entirely. Fix is in scripts/generate-exclusion-sweep.py: a per-group probe vector, plus a baseline assertion that every planted spelling is REACHABLE before anything is excluded.
5. MEDIUM — جوز ON THE COOK SIDE. Recorded in the code comment now. Needs the Customer and Cook form sets split, or the meal-analysis prompt pinned to emit عين جمل for walnut with a golden case. The extractor is AI and models drift to MSA, where walnut IS جوز.
6. MEDIUM — searchFilteredOn SAYS المكتوب فيها, 'the ones with {food} WRITTEN in them', and the mayonnaise and tuna decisions made that literally untrue: a mayonnaise Meal does not have بيض written in it. Dropping المكتوب makes it true again and the provenance clause already carries the AI-estimate disclosure. Founder's, because it is Arabic copy.
7. MEDIUM — A NEW UNEXPLAINED-EMPTY-SCREEN PATH. When the filter removes everything the empty branch renders searchFoundNothing WITHOUT searchFilteredOn, so the Customer is never told an exclusion is why. Before these additions من غير مايونيز left the results intact.
8. MEDIUM — MARKER PRECEDENCE IS BY LIST INDEX, NOT SENTENCE POSITION. مبكلش لحمة وبدون بصل answers onion. Pre-existing: بدون بصل ومن غير لحمة answers meat on the old markers alone. Fix is to pick the marker by earliest match position, tie-broken by list index.
